en: Fixed remote and headless sessions reporting "waiting for your input" while background agents were still running (set `CLAUDE_CODE_BG_TASKS_REPORT_RUNNING=0` to restore the old behavior)
zh: 修复了远程和无头 session 在后台 agent 仍在运行时报告“waiting for your input”的问题（设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_BG_TASKS_REPORT_RUNNING=0` 可恢复旧行为）
